_howto: Paste the direct download link of the ND Secretary of State CSV export into 'url'. In Chrome: open https://resultsnd.sos.nd.gov/#election=348 , Exports, download the 'General Election' CSV, then open chrome://downloads and copy the link shown under the file name. Use the big all-contests file as the first source. The smaller 'State' file is optional backup for statewide races. Leave a url empty to skip it.
